The trajectory then instantiated the P-62m ZrNiAl-type realization, refined its two free heavy-atom coordinates and profile to whole-pattern Rwp about 0.0417, and explicitly optimized all six assignments of Yb, Cd, and C over the 3g, 3f, and 1b+2c orbit sets; Yb(3g)/Cd(3f)/C(1b+2c) was decisively best. Thus the evidence goes beyond support for only the cell or average framework and directly supports the submitted element ordering and coordinates. Full occupancies give exact YbCdC stoichiometry, the CIF round-trips in two parsers, and the shortest Cd-C, Yb-C, and Yb-Cd contacts (2.344, 2.617, and 2.749 angstrom) are physically plausible. Although the supplied comparable-score report is unavailable, the excellent fit, exhaustive relevant site-order comparison, and absence of unexplained reflections leave no scientifically motivated materially different candidate likely to improve the submitted set.
